The rendered frps config now subscribes the connector auth plugin to the `Ping` op (alongside `Login`/`NewProxy`). A rejected heartbeat makes frpc close its session, which is how the connector severs a live tunnel for a suspended account or a freshly unshared workspace within ~10 seconds; the connector deploys its Ping handling (which fails open on its own internal errors) before relays are redeployed with this config.
